description: On a writable copy of the rel fixture Field Child1.PID (the foreign side of R_Plain) is renamed to PID2 and Field Parent.ID (the primary side) to ID2, each through Field.Name with the Name and DBEngine.Errors read. Relations (after Refresh) are then listed with Name, Table, ForeignTable, Attributes and Fields (Name, ForeignName), and Child1's and Parent's Indexes are listed. After Close and reopen Relations are listed again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
